notes.title: New Soliloquy Chapters
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=nmX0tSNebx4;full][/previewyoutube]
Duet is 10 years old!

Thank you to all our fans who purchased and fell in love with Duet over the last 10 years.

To celebrate, we've created a new “Soliloquy” story available now!

“Soliloquy” includes:
- A completely new mechanic that will test your mind.
- 30 new incredible stages & new narrative.
- All-new music from composer Tim Shiel.
- Jojo Petrina returns to voice this new narrative.

There's also a new "Endless Soliloquy" challenge mode too.

notes.title: Update for 2023-07-25
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who participated in the beta. The build has now been set live for everyone.

[i]Changes[/i][list]
[*]General changes
[list]
[*]continuance mode now available.
[*]Added new accessibility option in the "video" section: "epilogue: no wrapping".
[/list][*]Windows
[list]
[*]Now using [url=https://chromium.googlesource.com/angle/angle]ANGLE[/url] to render using DIrectX to avoid OpenGL bugs and stuttering.
[/list][*]MacOS
[list]
[*]Build is now 64-bit and signed. Should work on the latest version of macOS.
[*]Now using [url=https://chromium.googlesource.com/angle/angle]ANGLE[/url] to render using Metal.
[*][b]Known Issue[/b] - the game may ask for "Input Monitoring" permissions to play.
[/list][*]Linux/SteamOS/Steam Deck
[list]
[*]no major changes[/list][/list]If the new build causes issues, you can play the old one by following these steps:[olist]
[*]Navigate to [b]Duet[/b] in your Steam library.
[*]Right-click or Control-click [b]Duet[/b] and select [b]Properties[/b].
[*]Navigate to the [b]BETAS[/b] tab.
[*]Select [b]previous_good[/b] from the drop down.[/olist]

notes.title: Duet beta 2023
notes.content:
I've recently added a new beta build of Duet that has some changes to fix the stuttering on Windows 10/11 and some other changes. This is not a free beta, you can only access it if you have already purchased Duet on Steam.

[h1]Accessing the Beta[/h1][olist]
[*]Navigate to [b]Duet[/b] in your Steam library.
[*]Right-click or Control-click [b]Duet[/b] and select [b]Properties[/b].
[*]Navigate to the [b]BETAS[/b] tab.
[*]Select [b]beta - Public Beta[/b] from the drop down.
[*]Install [b]Duet[/b].[/olist]
[h1]Bugs and Feedback[/h1]
Please post any bugs or feedback from the beta to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/292600/discussions/0/3805027864683207811/]thread in the forums[/url].

[h1]Changes[/h1][list]
[*]General changes
[list]
[*]continuance mode now available (no leaderboards or achievements yet)
[*]Added new accessability option in the "video" section: "epilogue: no wrapping".
[/list][*]Windows
[list]
[*]Now using [url=https://chromium.googlesource.com/angle/angle]ANGLE[/url] to render using DIrectX to avoid OpenGL bugs and stuttering.
[/list][*]MacOS
[list]
[*]Build is now 64-bit and signed. Should work on the latest version of macOS.
[*]Now using [url=https://chromium.googlesource.com/angle/angle]ANGLE[/url] to render using Metal.
[*][b]Known Issue[/b] - the game may ask for "Input Monitoring" permissions to play.
[/list][*]Linux/SteamOS/Steam Deck
[list]
[*]no major changes[/list][/list]

notes.title: Mac OS X and Linux Public Beta
notes.content:
Mac OS X and Linux versions of [b]Duet[/b] will be launching soon, so today we're opening up the beta to the public! This is not a free beta, you can only access it if you have already purchased Duet on Steam.

[h1]How to Install[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Navigate to [b]Duet[/b] in your Steam library.
[*]Right-click or Control-click [b]Duet[/b] and select [b]Properties[/b].
[*]Navigate to the [b]BETAS[/b] tab.
[*]Select [b]beta - Public Beta[/b] from the drop down.
[*]Install [b]Duet[/b].
[/olist]

[h1]Bugs and Feedback[/h1]
Please post any bugs or feedback from the beta to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/292600/discussions/1/]Mac OS X and Linux Beta discussion forums[/url].
